filing_fee_notes: Online formation is 130; paper formation is 170. The domestic annual-report base fee is 25; paper filing adds 15.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain a Wisconsin registered agent and registered office. The agent may be an eligible Wisconsin resident or qualifying business entity.
expedite_options: Expedited service is available for an additional 100 for next-business-day processing.
annual_report_due: Last day of the calendar quarter containing the formation anniversary: March 31, June 30, September 30 or December 31. First due in the calendar year after formation.
plain_english_summary: Online formation costs 130 and the domestic annual report costs 25. Paper filing costs more.
common_mistake: The annual report is due at the end of the formation quarter.
notes: Ordinary domestic LLC; foreign LLC report fees differ. Filing URLs are official gateways. Name-search URL, standard processing time, franchise or privilege tax, publication requirement and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
